inputs.text: Job Sikhala, the former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader, is urging people to reject proposed constitutional amendments reportedly designed to extend President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term to 2030. When those in power seek to change the rules to stay in power longer, the stakes go beyond party politics: it weakens democratic accountability and leaves ordinary people with less say over who governs them. The public deserves a transparent debate and institutions that protect its right to choose its leaders.
